scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/core/dist packages/cli/dist packages/agentfile/dist packages/ui/dist packages/extension/dist
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run build -w packages/agentfile && npm run build -w packages/extension
scripts.publish:core: npm run build -w packages/core && npm publish --workspace packages/core
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build -w packages/cli  && npm publish --workspace packages/cli
scripts.publish:wrapper: npm run build -w packages/agentfile && npm publish --workspace packages/agentfile
scripts.publish:ui: npm run build -w packages/ui && npm publish --workspace packages/ui --tag beta
scripts.publish:extension: npm run build -w packages/extension && npm run publish:marketplace -w packages/extension
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:core && npm run publish:cli && npm run publish:wrapper && npm run publish:ui
